test_cases.name: c22_write
test_cases.desc: Clause 22 write frame (ST=01, OP=01) updates register REGAD in PHY PHYAD.

test_cases.name: c22_read
test_cases.desc: Clause 22 read frame (ST=01, OP=10) with Z0 turnaround returns 16-bit data from the PHY.

test_cases.name: phyad_select
test_cases.desc: Only the PHY whose strapped address matches PHYAD responds; others stay high-impedance.

test_cases.name: c45_address
test_cases.desc: Clause 45 Address frame (ST=00, OP=00) loads a 16-bit register address into the MMD.

test_cases.name: c45_read_inc
test_cases.desc: Clause 45 Read-and-Increment (OP=10) reads then post-increments the register address.

test_cases.name: turnaround_read
test_cases.desc: On read, STA tri-states MDIO in TA bit 1 and the PHY drives 0 in TA bit 2 before data.

test_cases.name: preamble_suppression
test_cases.desc: A PHY in preamble-suppression mode accepts a frame without the 32-bit preamble.
